Every nonempty original paragraph was read and received manually authored preservation
facets. Sentence expectations retain full source quotes, exact original UTF-8 byte/line
spans, paragraph speaker/claim context and publication anchors. These preserve facts,
conditions, exceptions, negation, time, uncertainty, disagreements and explicit relations
with their direction. Questions, attributed testimony, allegations and predictions cannot
be promoted into established facts. Captions and roundup side topics remain included.
Source metadata remains bound to its original; UUID-looking source text is ordinary
content, not machine identity. Generic public exclusion categories conceal original
labels; the private inventory records the precise reason for every excluded span.

All six encoded original bodies match the retained raw index hashes. Their reconstructed
reference Markdown exactly matches five frozen originals and the unchanged rejected
original. Five generated writeback files at the old working paths are different source
surfaces and cannot supply original evidence spans. Blank-line/inter-sentence whitespace
is layout only. No original, historical packet, model request or response was edited.

The restricted inventory is recoverable at private immutable commit
`2055faa898418f1f88f90544b0ba6c98d4cf5d62`, directory
`cairn/v011-inventory-20261026` in the existing authorized private evidence repository.
Its manifest SHA256 is `e1f13c295d819328f02a7ee7e73c6ec6ab68d4cd85c7f7821398efb03d8c7602`;
the reviewed full inventory is 1,134,669 bytes, SHA256
`f0bfc3a6b8d802f3b15fe7c7e2f6db2e8c09ea4feb7564b241b76d42f78e44d8`.
Seven bounded base64 parts reconstruct a deterministic archive. Every final-commit file
was read back and checked; fresh reconstruction verifies every original and inventory
hash. Original identities/content/hashes remain restricted. The private builder's
aggregate contains detailed exclusion labels and must remain private; this public
summary uses only normalized generic categories.

`inventory_span_check.py` verifies exact source identity, byte/line spans, all
non-whitespace coverage, no overlapping units, attached interpretation facets,
publication anchors, exclusions, qualifiers, relation evidence and public aggregates.
Its six adversarial synthetic tests pass. The actual six-original provenance and summary
comparison passes with 360 covered substantive units. These are structural checks.
A separate session reviewed all six originals, all expected meanings, exclusions and
194 relation contexts, then accepted the corrected final inventory digest above. Same
model/account limits apply; this is not independent provider or empirical replication.

Downstream owners use the inventory as acceptance evidence, never as construction model
input. v0.1.2 checks source-to-annotation fidelity including rejected/removed rows;
v0.1.3 preserves every distinction and incidence through mapping/fusion/detail;
v0.1.4 preserves explicit relation endpoints, direction, qualifiers and source bindings;
v0.1.5 verifies semantics/provenance in persisted and generated representations;
v0.1.6 compares the ordinary full, repeated and changed-document output against all
expected meanings. Graph detail may preserve a supported relation when no edge enum fits.
Retained inferred relations cannot receive explicit-original credit. No graph completeness,
old QA utility, provider factual truth or downstream implementation result is asserted.
